title: Miso y la cometa perdida
style: 3D animated feature film, stylized CGI, soft global illumination, warm palette, shallow depth of field

characters.miso: young orange tabby cat walking upright, emerald-green eyes, teal neckerchief, cheerful child voice
characters.pipa: small red squirrel girl, half Miso's height, big dark eyes, yellow flower behind ear, sweet little girl voice

shots.shot: wide establishing, camera cranes down from the sky
shots.action: Sunny morning in a lush park with a big oak tree. Miso walks happily along the path, whistling.
Miso hears soft crying, stops and turns his head, curious, ears perked up.
Under the oak, Pipa points up at her red kite tangled in the high branches, teary-eyed.
Miso puffs his chest and jumps as high as he can, but barely reaches halfway up the trunk and lands on his bottom.
Miso climbs the trunk and crawls along a branch that bends dangerously under his weight.
Miso grabs the kite; a gust of wind lifts it and Miso dangles from the kite string, legs kicking.
Miso falls into a big pile of autumn leaves; the kite gently lands on top of his head.
Pipa giggles; Miso, covered in leaves, hands her the kite with a proud smile.

shots.shot: wide, golden-hour sunset, camera rises to the sky
shots.action: Miso and Pipa fly the red kite together on a hill, laughing.
